extName.message: Скорость видео: RuTube, Дзен, VK, YouTube
extName.description: Store listing title shown to Russian-speaking users. This locale is the point of the exercise: the sites this extension is actually for are Russian, yet 86% of installs came from English speakers because the store had a single English listing.
